body:
### ESLint version

v10.11.0

### What problem do you want to solve?

Vulnerability databases flagged `minimatch` < 11.0.1 for [CVE-2026-118764](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-118764) - High risk.
Unfortunately, eslint consumes 10.2.6 and there are breaking changes between minimatch v10.x and v11.
As far as I can see, v10 of minimatch does not seem to receive a patch to address CVE-2026-118764 (although I can open an issue there, see if that's something more easily achievable than updating it to 11.0.1 for eslint).

eslint-plugin-import-x also uses minimatch 10.2.6

Any thoughts on this appreciated, thank you!

### What do you think is the correct solution?

Use minimatch 11.0.1 or greater

### Participation

- [ ] I am willing to submit a pull request for this change.

### AI acknowledgment

- [x] I did not use AI to generate this issue report.
- [ ] (If the above is not checked) I have reviewed the AI-generated content before submitting.

### Additional comments

_No response_

comments.body:
Confirming there's no fixed 10.x: the advisory (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) lists `< 11.0.1`, and the npm registry has nothing newer than 10.2.6 on the 10 line.

The breaking changes in 11 shouldn't affect eslint. 11 removes `makeRe`, `AST` and the `debug` option. eslint (`lib/eslint/eslint-helpers.js`) and `@eslint/config-array` only use `new Minimatch(pattern, { dot, flipNegate })` and `.match(path, partial)`, which 11 keeps.

I tried it with an npm override (`"overrides": { "minimatch": "11.0.3" }`) on eslint 10.14.0. eslint linted exactly the same files on 10.2.6 and 11.0.3: no ignore, `--ignore-pattern 'src/scenes/**'`, that pattern plus a `!` negation, and `--ignore-pattern '**/*.ts'` all matched. The override works as a stopgap until eslint moves to 11.

Well spotted! The forced override was failing for me; but that was actually because of eslint-plugin-import-x (fork of eslint-plugin-import) which uses makeRe and breaks with minimatch 11.x. I will address it there.

👋 Hi! This issue is being addressed in pull request https://github.com/eslint/eslint/pull/21492. Thanks, @nikolawork!

title: Change Request: Use minimatch 11.0.1 or greater
